{{EventEnd|date=21st of December 2023}} {{For|other uses of [[Lunar (Disambiguation)|Lunar]]}} {{EventInfobox |title1 = Lunar Overture Event |image1 = Halloween2023BP.png |dates = 28 October 2023 – 21 December 2023 |acts = 3 |tracks = 1 |previous_event = [[Violent Night Event|Violent Night]] |next_event = [[Krampus' Revenge Event|Krampus' Revenge]] |previous_pass = [[Violent Night Event#Violent Night Season Pass|Violent Night]] |next_pass = [[Krampus' Revenge Event#Krampus' Revenge Season Pass|Krampus' Revenge]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Lunar Overture Event''' was the twelfth event to be added to Tower Defense Simulator. This event brought two new event towers and a season pass, which required{{Pumpkins|Pumpkins}} to reach higher ranks. This event was separated into three acts, which were three different maps with unique enemies and wave structure, with each act getting harder. The [[A Dark Tale|first act]] was released a few hours after the [[v1.9.0|Lunar Overture Update]] released (on the 28th of October 2023), the [[The Haunted Past|second act]] was released on the 31st of October 2023, and the [[The Great Finale|third act]] was released on the 12th of November 2023. The event started on the 28th of October 2023 and ended the 21st of December 2023. ==Lunar Overture Season Pass== [[File:LunarOvertureSeasonPass.png|center|500px|thumb]] {{Pumpkins|Pumpkins}} were this event's currency. They were collected by killing enemies that spawn with randomly chosen pumpkin hats. All naturally spawned enemies can spawn with one of these hats. These enemies drop between one and three {{Pumpkins|Pumpkins}} when killed, which have to be collected by walking up to them. In total, it took {{Pumpkins|5,200 Pumpkins}} or {{Robux|5,900}} to complete the season pass. {{BattlePass |Pass = Lunar Overture |Pass Type = Season |Level Name = Rank |Regular Image = Umbracutout.png|[[The Umbra]] cardboard cutout from the lobby. }} ==Trivia== *The theater all the maps take place in is called ''Solar Theatres''. *The '''Lunar Overture Event''' was the first event to feature cutscenes. **Additionally, this is also the first event to feature animated narrators. *This is also the first event to give out UGC accessories as a reward for completing it. **However, it is not the first event to give out accessories, which would be the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. *Weirdly, a render of the {{Color|Other|Umbra}} [[Commander]] skin is used for the season pass, despite this skin not being obtainable from the season but the [[Umbra Mini Plush]]. *The skins shown off in the season pass uses portview models instead of a custom render. **Because of this, most rewards in the [[Gift Box]] did not have images showcasing the reward. *An overture is an orchestral piece that is conducted at the start of various performances, including plays. **Additionally, overture is from the French word "ouverture", meaning "opening" or "setting up". *On the 3rd of November 2023, cardboard cutouts of towers and enemies were added to the audience in the lobby. The [[Scout]], [[Commander]], [[Gladiator]] and [[The Umbra]] can be seen in the audience. **These were meant to appear in the scrapped cutscene for Act 3, but since the cutscene was cut, they never appeared anywhere outside the lobby. **The cardboard cutouts were drawn by BelowNatural's girlfriendhttps://x.com/BelowNatural/status/1929973835861770336. *In the [[Hexscape Event]], the [[Dispatcher]] refers to this event as the "''Overture Incident''". *The [[Necromancer]] added as part of this event was actually originally the final reward for the event's season, but it was turned into a gem tower once the second part of the season could be progressed through by players. ==Notes== {{EventNavBox}} [[Category:Passes]]
